text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of Hishi Akebono's Make Debut. Her 
extraordinary, larger-than-life size 
captivated countless spectators.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
“I'm going to give it everything I've 
got!” Amidst her declaration and roaring 
applause, the curtain rose on her debut 
race!
